column1: # Library functions in the ELF with no C++ here, on purpose (libraries are never rewritten). Either
# nothing on the PC reaches them, so the recompiled image keeps them and nobody reads them, or they are Sony's, with
# no source of the pinned version on disk and no replacement in the runtime, and run as the recompiled originals.
# Columns: address, library, name, in the other games (DM2 PS2, BMX XXX PS2: identical, close or none), why.
